candidates.name: 01 · Amber classic
candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready raster UI slider thumb for a touch-screen starship engineering console. Generate exactly ONE isolated handle, centered, straight-on orthographic TOP VIEW, no perspective tilt. A chunky regular hexagon with a point at top and bottom, a strong readable silhouette at 56px display size. Square canvas, handle occupies about 80% of canvas, fully visible, equal transparent margins. Warm studio light from upper left, subtle beveled thickness only at edges, restrained realistic materials, retro industrial spaceship hardware. Transparent background with true alpha; no panel, track, surroundings, floor, typography, logos, labels, numbers, borders around canvas, or cast shadow outside the handle. Design candidate 1: faithfully evocative of a physical arcade engineering controller: a thick ochre amber molded hexagonal outer grip, slightly rounded bevels, and a flat inset smaller hexagonal gray pebbled metal center. Minimal surface detail, a narrow dark seam and dark lower edge giving tactile depth. The amber ring is broad and prominent. Satin orange-gold and cool gray, clean gently used equipment, no heavy grime.
